sentence: This project links large population-based data sets to find out which factors shape health outcomes for autistic children.
This project works to improve understanding of taste, smell, and related senses.
This project tries to find out what metabolic transporters do and how they matter for renal physiology and disease.
This project builds tissue engineering tools that monitor how triple negative breast cancer responds to therapy, to spot resistance early.
This project builds a microscope method that records 3D neuronal activity in deep tissues at high speed.
This project studies how tumor cells that spread to lymph nodes cause immune tolerance in mice and help the disease reach distant sites.
This project builds miniature silicon-based devices that scan and sense in flexible instruments for live imaging.
This project uses machine learning to study whether neural instrumental learning systems in adolescents who use cannabis predict treatment success.
This project studies what causes calcific aortic stenosis, including in people born with a bicuspid aortic valve.
This project builds computer methods that let researchers train shared machine learning models without sharing data, while reducing bias and privacy problems.
This project tests whether fusion oncoproteins cause cancer by forming biomolecular condensates in several kinds of pediatric cancer.
This project studies how epigenetic modifiers affect oncoproteins in high-risk neuroblastoma and tries to develop better therapies.
This project tries to find out which germline copy number variants are linked to prostate cancer risk in men of African and European ancestry.
This project studies the signaling pathways that help lung cancer cells overcome stress and pass a metabolic checkpoint.
This project tests emerging cancer screening technologies in several study cohorts, aiming to reduce cancer-related mortality.
This project tests whether raising insulin signaling in astrocytes in mouse models of Alzheimer's disease normalizes cerebrovascular, metabolic, and neuronal changes.
This project builds a mobile phone imaging device that uses deep learning to screen for oral cancer early in low-resource settings.
This project tests whether silencing one of three copies of chromosome 21 in a Down Syndrome mouse model returns its traits toward normal.
This project studies the genetics and brain biology behind alcohol use disorder and tests possible treatments in animal and human laboratory models.
This project builds human tissue models from stem cells that include immune cells, to study how they shift between inflammatory and anti-inflammatory states.
